lines.zh: 上塔楼得走三十级台阶。
lines.en: Thirty steps to the tower top.
Soft feet — don't spook the prey.
My quiver knocks at my hip.
Walk the wall for a clear field of view.
Changing post, this one's cramped.
String's loose — tuning it as I walk.

lines.zh: 风从东边来，我得往西挪。
lines.en: Wind from the east, so I shift west.

lines.zh: 巡到塔角，就看得见整片田。
lines.en: At the tower corner I can see all the fields.
Mind that loose plank.

lines.zh: 我走路留着半只眼的空。
lines.en: I keep one eye on the distance.

lines.zh: 靴底薄，踩什么都感觉得到。
lines.en: Thin soles — I feel every stone.
Three quivers' worth — enough for a while.
String waxed, waiting for a target.
Counting distant smoke columns.
Squinting at the grass to read the wind.
This fletching's slightly bent.
The tower is quieter than the ground.
I never loose for nothing — arrows cost.

lines.zh: 听见了吗？林子那边有响。
lines.en: Hear that? Something in the trees.
Wax under my nails from the string.
Holding still is the hard part of watch.
These crenels sit a bit low.
Hold still, I'm counting your stride.
You're standing in my firing lane.
Look up — I'm watching from the tower.
That cloak of yours stands out.

lines.zh: 走近点，我要看清你的手。
lines.en: Closer — I want to see your hands.
The one with the bow speaks first.
Hiding behind that tree won't help.
Green tower — come no closer.
I'd rather not shoot a person.
A quiver on your back? A fellow archer?
I know exactly how far my arrow flies.
Hands up, then lower them slowly.
My hand slipped — dry loose.

lines.zh: 肩膀挨了一下，拉不满弓。
lines.en: Shoulder hit — can't draw full.
Ducking behind the crenel to breathe.
Blood dripping on the fletching.
I can still draw. Stay back.
I don't dare loose this one.
Knee cracked against the stone.
Vision's whitening — give me a moment.
Switch hands, I can hold.
Getting hurt up high is the worst.
Roast venison? I smell the fat.

lines.zh: 给我留点，我盯了一上午。
lines.en: Save me some, I've watched all morning.
Leave the jug at the tower base.
I won't leave the tower for food.

lines.zh: 这香味会暴露我们的位置。
lines.en: That smell gives our position away.
Once relieved, I'll eat.
Who's roasting mushrooms down there?
Don't trade food for my arrows.
Hungry, but the hand mustn't shake.
Bump me and the bow shifts.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，弦会蹭到你。
lines.en: Not so close, the string'll catch you.

lines.zh: 往后一点，我脚下没地方退。
lines.en: Back up, there's no room up here.
You're standing on my arrows.
These stairs fit one at a time.
Clear the way, changing posts.
Knocked my bow arm off — took ages to reset.
Steady, the crenel's narrow.
You're crowding the edge — dangerous.

lines.zh: 别从背后过来，我会转身。
lines.en: Don't come from behind, I turn fast.
The string matters more right now.

lines.zh: 我连箭都数不完，哪有空。
lines.en: I can't even finish counting arrows.

lines.zh: 找个不是塔楼的地方吧。
lines.en: Somewhere that isn't a tower.
Talk after this fight.
I'd shake too much to shoot straight.
Camp rules are strict. Don't.
My bow's still on my shoulder.
Too windy to talk about it.
Not on the edge of a crenel.
I only get close to my quiver.
This arrow's still good.
Recovering misses — arrows are precious.
Cloth — good for wiping the bow.
A sharpening stone too? Yes.
Broken shafts make good wedges.
This feather can fix fletching.
Dropped bowstring — mine.
A chip of wax for the string.
Don't block me, I'm picking up arrows.
Coins inside, arrows outside.
Target entered my lane.
Half draw — not yet.
He's in the open. Foolish.
Wind pushes left, aim half a finger right.
Roughly forty paces.
I can see the gap in his armor.
Bow up and aim — quiet now.
He's stopped. Perfect.
Let the archer open the fight.
Shoot from the crenel, keep the shoulder in.
He looked up — loose!

lines.zh: 我把箭头对准他的胸口。
lines.en: Point set on his chest.
Three arrows should settle it.
Ranged in — steady now.
He doesn't know I'm up here.
Three more steps.
He's behind his shield now.
Then I'll take his leg.
He won't hold still — hard to aim.
Arrow nocked, holding.
He's pushing in — I'll call the others.
From this angle I can only graze.
He's moving crenel to crenel.
Full draw, hand trembling.
One breath more and he'll turn.
He's guarding his helm — afraid of arrows.
Shifting to the tower corner for a better angle.
He stepped back — tracking.
I don't chase people, I loose arrows.
Slowing my breath to nothing.
At this range, the bow arm swings.
Three steps back and I can shoot.
The knife only after the arrows.
Don't crowd me, the bow can't open.
This one goes for your wrist.
I shove you off, then draw.
Using an arrow like a small spear.
Close in I'm at a disadvantage — be quick.
Hit the weapon hand.
The string caught you — back off.
I only need one gap.
Shove him off and get back to the tower.
Kick instead of wasting the bow.
Not accurate, but it landed hard.
He's got my quiver.
Not the bow — that's my life.
One turn and I'm shooting.
Just hold until someone comes.
Up the tower, string the bow.
This green tower is mine to watch.
Fresh-cut shafts with me.

lines.zh: 从箭垛后面探出半个头。
lines.en: Half a head over the parapet.
Two li of open ground from here.
Wind first, then targets.

lines.zh: 我来接前一个人的位置。
lines.en: Taking over from the last one.
Up the steps, bow over the shoulder.

lines.zh: 有人守墙，就有人守高处。
lines.en: Some hold the wall, some hold the height.
Onto the tower deck — the wood creaks.

lines.zh: 队长指了塔，我就上去了。
lines.en: Captain pointed at the tower, so up I went.

lines.zh: 我得先找到能射的角度。
lines.en: First I need a shooting angle.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上弓臂，木头在响。
lines.en: Flame licks the bow arm — the wood pops.

lines.zh: 从塔上掉下去了，落得真快。
lines.en: Off the tower — the fall was so fast.
Water in the quiver — ruined arrows.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被震下垛口。
lines.en: The blast knocked me off the parapet.
Their arrow was truer than mine.
Spell-light blurs my aim.
Empty belly, I can't draw full.

lines.zh: 雷打中塔顶，我滚了一身灰。
lines.en: Lightning struck the tower — I'm all ash.
I look down and there's only black.
